Registry methodology

What a profile means

Identity

Exact-name resolution helps avoid mixing a bank with its parent, subsidiary, servicer, collector or similarly named company.

Official records

Primary regulator, enforcement and filing sources come before news summaries.

Consumer signals

Complaints and Registry reports are context. They are not adjudicated findings and must not be presented as proven wrongdoing.
